selection: Maximize development leave-one-match-out mean binary dead F1, equal weight per match and clean/moderate/severe regime. Tie-break on dead recall, then variant name and threshold. No validation tuning.
note: Train at approximately 1 Hz, infer at native 25 Hz. All source frames contribute to label-free temporal features. Fixed settings before model fitting. Calibration is measured, not assumed, especially with spell weights. Published-period masks only; no competition inputs or labels.
